item.title: 2026-06-08 Evening News Podcast
item.description:
# 🌆 Evening News Podcast (Basic English 850 Words Edition)

欢迎阅读今天的晚报！所有的英文正文均严格限制在 Basic English 850 核心词汇内（专有名词除外），这是专为你生成的深度晚报演示版。

**Good evening. This is your news for the day.**
*晚上好。这是今天的资讯。*

**We will start with the strong shaking of the earth in the Philippines. A great moving of the earth, with a measure of 7.8, caused the fall of many high buildings and houses in the south of the country. At least 32 persons met their death, and many more are without their homes tonight. At first, the government put out a danger sign for a great sea wave, but they took it away after some hours. The people living there are full of fear, but helpers are working through the night to give food and water.**
*我们先从菲律宾强烈的地震（地球震动）开始。一场震级为7.8级的强烈地震（地球大运动）导致了该国南部许多高楼和房屋的倒塌。至少有32人遇难，今晚还有更多人无家可归。起初，政府发出了巨大海浪（海啸）的危险警告信号，但在几个小时后取消了。住在那里的人们充满了恐惧，但是救援人员（帮助者）正在彻夜工作以提供食物和水。*

**In other news, China's Xi Jinping makes a journey to North Korea to see Kim Jong Un. This is an important political move because such a journey is not common. They had a long talk about working together and giving support to one another. The United States and other countries are looking at this meeting with great care, as it may change the balance of power in that part of the world.**
*在其他新闻方面，中国国家主席习近平前往朝鲜会见金正恩。这是一个重要的政治举动，因为这样的访问并不常见。他们就如何共同合作和相互支持进行了长谈。美国和其他国家正在非常谨慎地关注这次会面，因为它可能会改变世界那个地区的力量平衡。*

**Finally, in Armenia, the government leader Nikol Pashinyan says he had a great win in the political selection of a new government. This selection was seen by many as a test of Russia's power over the country. Pashinyan wants to move his country closer to the West. Even with strong pressure from Russia, the people of Armenia gave their support to his new direction.**
*最后，在亚美尼亚，政府领导人（总理）尼科尔·帕希尼扬表示，他在新政府的政治选举（政治挑选）中取得了巨大胜利。这次选举被许多人视为对俄罗斯对该国影响力的考验。帕希尼扬希望他的国家向西方靠拢。即使在俄罗斯的强大压力下，亚美尼亚人民仍然对他的新方向给予了支持。*

**This comes to the end of our evening news. Have a good rest, and we will see you tomorrow.**
*我们的晚间新闻到此结束。好好休息，我们明天见。*

item.title: 2026-06-08 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
# 🌅 Morning News Podcast (Basic English 850 Words Edition)

欢迎阅读今天的早报！所有的英文正文均严格限制在 Basic English 850 核心词汇内（专有名词除外），帮你用最简单的词汇看懂全球大事。

**Good morning. Here is the news for today.**
*早上好。这是今天的新闻。*

**First, Trump says to Netanyahu: Do not make an attack on Iran. This is a very important word between the two countries.**
*首先，特朗普对内塔尼亚胡说：不要对伊朗发动攻击。这是两国之间非常重要的一番话。*

**Second, in the Philippines, the earth had a strong shaking which caused deaths. Now, the government says the danger of a great sea wave is gone, so they take away the sign of danger.**
*第二，在菲律宾，大地发生了强烈的震动（地震）并导致了死亡。现在，政府说巨大海浪（海啸）的危险已经过去，所以他们取消了危险警告。*

**Third, China's Xi Jinping comes to North Korea for an important journey to see the country. A journey like this is not common and has a great government effect.**
*第三，中国的习近平来到朝鲜，进行了一次重要的视察之旅。像这样的旅程并不常见，并且有着巨大的政治（政府）影响。*

**This is all for the morning. Have a good day.**
*这就是今天早上的全部内容。祝你今天过得愉快。*

item.title: 2026-06-09 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
# Morning News Podcast: Technology, Finance, and World Events
# 晨间新闻播客：科技、金融与国际大事

Good morning. Welcome to our Morning News Podcast. Today is a new day, and we have many things to talk about.
早上好。欢迎收听我们的晨间新闻播客。今天是新的一天，我们有很多事情要谈。

In this podcast, we talk about the news of the world. We use simple words so that everyone can understand.
在这个播客中，我们用简单的词汇讨论世界新闻，以便每个人都能听懂。

## Apple's Big Day: WWDC 2026 and iOS 27
## 苹果的大日子：WWDC 2026 与 iOS 27

Our first story is about Apple. Every year, they have a big meeting called WWDC. This year, the chief man of Apple, Tim Cook, showed the world the new system for the iPhone, called iOS 27.
我们的第一个故事是关于苹果的。每年，他们都会举办一个名为 WWDC 的大型会议。今年，苹果掌门人蒂姆·库克向世界展示了 iPhone 的新系统，名为 iOS 27。

The biggest thing is Siri. For a long time, Siri was not very wise. Now, Apple is giving Siri a new brain called Apple Intelligence.
最大的亮点是 Siri。很长一段时间以来，Siri 都不怎么聪明。现在，苹果给 Siri 换上了一个名为“苹果智能”（Apple Intelligence）的新大脑。

This new Siri can understand your life. It can read your letters, look at your pictures, and help you find information.
这个新的 Siri 可以理解你的生活。它可以阅读你的信件，查看你的照片，并帮助你查找信息。

Some people are worried about their secrets. But Tim Cook says the machine brain does most of its thinking inside your pocket machine, so your secrets are safe.
有些人担心自己的秘密泄露。但蒂姆·库克表示，这个机器大脑的大部分思考过程都在你的口袋机器（手机）内部进行，因此你的秘密是安全的。

## Xbox Games Showcase and Gears of War: E-Day
## Xbox 游戏发布会与《战争机器：事变日》

Microsoft has a big machine for play called the Xbox. This summer, they showed many beautiful plays, including Gears of War: E-Day.
微软有一款名为 Xbox 的大型游戏机。今年夏天，他们展示了许多精美的游戏，包括《战争机器：事变日》（Gears of War: E-Day）。

This play goes back to the very start of the story. It shows the first day the monsters came out of the earth.
这部游戏回到了故事的最开始。它展示了怪物从地下钻出来的第一天。

Microsoft hopes this play will make people buy the Xbox instead of Sony's PlayStation. They call these plays "exclusives" because you can only play them on Xbox.
微软希望这部游戏能吸引人们购买 Xbox，而不是索尼的 PlayStation。他们称这些游戏为“独占游戏”，因为你只能在 Xbox 上玩到它们。

## Google's NotebookLM and Gemini 3.5
## 谷歌的 NotebookLM 与 Gemini 3.5

Google has a tool called NotebookLM that helps you read and learn. It uses a machine brain called Gemini 3.5.
谷歌有一款名为 NotebookLM 的工具，可以帮助你阅读和学习。它使用了一个名为 Gemini 3.5 的机器大脑。

If you have a long book, you can put it into the machine, and it will read it in one second. Then you can ask questions about the book.
如果你有一本很厚的书，你可以把它放进机器里，它会在一秒钟内读完。然后你可以提出关于这本书的问题。

The new update adds a cloud computer and a source finder. It will show you the exact page and line where it found the facts, so you can check if they are true.
新的更新增加了一台云端计算机和一个来源查找器。它会向你展示找到事实的具体页码和行数，以便你检查它们是否真实。

## Bending iPhones and Nvidia's RTX Spark
## 折叠 iPhone 与英伟达的 RTX Spark

A picture of a new folding iPhone was let out on the net. It looks very thin, and the line in the middle is almost invisible.
网络上流出了一张新型折叠 iPhone 的照片。它看起来非常薄，中间的折痕几乎看不见。

People say it will be called the iPhone Ultra and may have Touch ID again, letting you open it with your finger.
人们说它将被命名为 iPhone Ultra，并且可能会重新加入 Touch ID，让你用手指就能解锁。

At the same time, Nvidia has a new card called the RTX Spark. It makes pictures in games look very real by calculating how light moves in a room.
与此同时，英伟达推出了一款名为 RTX Spark 的新显卡。它通过计算光线在房间中的移动轨迹，使游戏中的画面看起来非常真实。

## Money Market and Bubble Fears
## 金融市场与泡沫担忧

The share market went up today, but some wise men on Wall Street are afraid. They say the year 2026 looks like the year 1999.
今天股票市场上涨了，但华尔街的一些聪明人却感到害怕。他们说 2026 年看起来很像 1999 年。

In 1999, there was a dot-com bubble. People bought shares in any internet company, but the companies did not make real money. In 2000, the bubble burst, and many people lost everything.
在 1999 年，出现了互联网泡沫。人们购买任何互联网公司的股票，但这些公司并没有赚到真钱。2000 年，泡沫破裂，许多人失去了一切。

Now, they fear the same thing is happening with machine brains. They say Wall Street is "out over their skis," which means they are going too fast and might fall.
现在，他们担心同样的事情也会发生在机器大脑（人工智能）身上。他们说华尔街“把雪橇滑得太靠前了”，这意味着他们走得太快，可能会摔倒。

## The Fight for the GLP-1 Pill
## GLP-1 药丸之战

Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly are competing to make a pill that helps people lose weight. This medicine makes people feel full so they eat less.
诺和诺德和礼来公司正在竞争生产一种帮助人们减肥的药丸。这种药物能让人产生饱腹感，从而减少进食。

Before, people had to use a needle. A pill is much easier to take.
以前，人们必须使用针头注射。而药丸服用起来要容易得多。

If the US government system, Medicare, agrees to pay for these pills, the companies will make a mountain of money.
如果美国政府的医疗保险系统（Medicare）同意为这些药丸买单，这些公司将会赚到堆积如山的财富。

## SpaceX and Retail Investors
## SpaceX 与散户投资者

SpaceX is Elon Musk's space company. Now, a company called Fidelity is letting normal people buy shares for $2,000.
SpaceX 是埃隆·马斯克的太空公司。现在，一家名为富达（Fidelity）的公司允许普通人以 2000 美元的价格购买其股份。

But the rules are very strict. If you do not follow them, you can be banned from buying new shares for life.
但是规则非常严格。如果你不遵守规则，你可能会被终生禁止购买新股。

## China's Domestic Progress: C919 and eVTOL
## 中国国内进展：C919 与 eVTOL

China's new passenger plane, the C919, is ready to replace old planes in China's domestic fleet. This shows the power of China's industry.
中国的新客机 C919 已准备好替代中国国内机队中的老旧飞机。这展示了中国工业的力量。

China also made its first domestic electric engine for eVTOL planes, which are like flying cars that can lift straight up into the air.
中国还为其 eVTOL 飞机制造了首款国产电动机，这种飞机就像可以直接升空飞行的汽车。

In the farm market, corn starch prices went down a little, which helps factories lower their costs.
在农产品市场，玉米淀粉价格略有下降，这有助于工厂降低成本。

Tesla's sales of China-made cars jumped by nearly 40 out of 100 in May, showing that Chinese buyers still love Tesla.
特斯拉 5 月份在中国制造的汽车销量增长了近 40%，表明中国买家仍然喜爱特斯拉。

## World Conflicts and Natural Disasters
## 国际冲突与自然灾害

The fight between Iran and Israel has stopped for now after Donald Trump told both sides to "stop shooting." Iran has removed all flight restrictions.
在唐纳德·特朗普告诉双方“停止射击”后，伊朗和以色列之间的冲突暂时停止了。伊朗已经取消了所有飞行限制。

But Israel's chief, Benjamin Netanyahu, warned that the struggle is not over.
但以色列领导人本雅明·内塔尼亚胡警告说，斗争还没有结束。

In the Philippines, a powerful earth shake killed at least 32 people and destroyed many buildings.
在菲律宾，一场强烈的地震造成至少 32 人死亡，并摧毁了许多建筑物。

In Pyongyang, China's chief Xi Jinping met with North Korea's Kim Jong Un to strengthen their strategic cooperation, as North Korea has been getting closer to Russia.
在平壤，中国领导人习近平与朝鲜的金正恩会面，以加强他们的战略合作，因为朝鲜最近与俄罗斯走得越来越近。
